Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the enforcement of speeding violations on certain private roads.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to enforcement of speeding violations on certainprivate roads; and amending RCW 46.61.419.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.61.419 and 2003 c 193 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: State, local, or county law enforcement personnel may enforcespeeding violations under RCW 46.61.400 on private roads within acommunity organized under chapter 64.32, 64.34, or 64.38 RCW if: (1) A majority of the homeowner's association's, condominiumassociation's, or association of apartment owners' board of directorsvotes to authorize the issuance of speeding infractions on its privateroads, and declares a speed limit not lower than twenty miles per hour; (2) A written agreement regarding the speeding enforcement issigned by the homeowner's association, condominium association, orassociation of apartment owners president and the chief law enforcementofficial of the city or county within whose jurisdiction the privateroad is located; (3) The homeowner's association, condominium association, or p. 1 HB 1592association of apartment owners has provided written notice to all ofthe homeowners, unit owners, or apartment owners describing the newauthority to issue speeding infractions; and (4) Signs have been posted declaring the speed limit at all vehicleentrances to the community.
